text:
rachael.sales: Heads-up  ACME Japan asked if we can drop the private deployment platform fee for year 1 in exchange for a 12-month committed spend. They're pushing for one invoice item rather than a long SOW. Need deal desk + SE + security take.

ton y.se: Are they expecting an on-prem air-gapped install or VPC with customer-managed networking? That changes the engineering and security effort.

rachael.sales: Initial ask is VPC private control plane with customer KMS. Procurement says they may request on-prem later. Start with VPC POC (60 days) then roll to production.

anita.eng: Technically VPC + customer KMS is straightforward. Onboarding effort ~2 eng-days for the VPC config, plus 4 additional days for KMS integration & key policy review. If they convert to on-prem later, that would be a separate SOW + packaging fee.

kevin.dealdesk: Pricing options we can offer for contract clarity: 1) promotional waiver of platform fee for first 90 days only; 2) convert platform fee into a reduced monthly managed-services line for committed term; 3) move deployment costs to a professional services line on the SOW.

kevin.dealdesk: Ballpark pricing (internal):
- Platform fee list: $22,000/mo
- Enterprise support: $4,500/mo
- One-time on-prem packaging: $35,000
- 12mo committed discount: 25% off platform fee -> $16,500/mo
- POC promo: First 60d at 0% (waived) if signed commit and payment terms net30

tara.security: We need to run the security questionnaire and confirm SOC2 artifacts + KMS integration pattern. Timeline to complete intake: 3-5 business days for initial info, up to 3 weeks for deeper artifacts. If they insist on audit reports for on-prem, add 2-3 weeks.

finance-bot: Reminder: Discounts that reduce invoiced amounts affect ARR and cashflow models. If we waive platform fee for 60-90 days, finance wants the final signed schedule to reflect the true commitment and invoiced MRR post-promotional period.

rachael.sales: Customer prefers a single line item (subscription) rather than separate services lines. Can we create a bundled monthly fee (subscription) that absorbs the one-time packaging amortized across months?

kevin.dealdesk: We can do amortization in the SOW: include a one-time professional services invoice but offer to amortize it over the 12-month commitment on billing. This keeps the published rate card intact while meeting their procurement preference. Legal will need to approve SOW language.

anita.eng: Also call out in the SOW SLA and capacity expectations for peak bursts. If they expect >500 RPS spikes we should add an explicit burst policy and potential overage terms.

customer.sato: Appreciate the clarity. Preference is 60d POC waived platform fee, then 12mo commit at reduced monthly. Will share estimated traffic profile today. Need to start onboarding within 10 business days if approved.

kevin.dealdesk: Next steps: I will prepare an internal summary for approvals (include estimated ARR post-discount). If the committed ARR exceeds $900k this needs VP approval; otherwise I can sign off with finance. Please post the estimated ARR here.

rachael.sales: Estimated post-POC ARR (after discount) = ~$520,000/year. Posting the SOW draft link in the thread in 30m.

tara.security: Ill pick up SEC intake once SOW link is posted. Assigned ticket SEC-2026-197. ETA first pass 72 hours.

kevin.dealdesk: Sounds good. I'll start the approval workflow. If anyone has objections to amortizing the packaging fee on billing, flag now.

rachael.sales: No objections. Thanks all  I'll update when the SOW and security intake are in. :thumbsup:
